title: fields: a failed first load of the lazy line-item grid chunk never recovers without a reload
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36102 (PR #36417, the line-item grid body loads lazily). L1-d (7078535343) named it out of scope and the PR lists it for the seat to file. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36102.

## What happens

`React.lazy` keeps a failed first load for the whole session. A host that renders `GridField` without first calling `preloadGridField()`, and whose first load of the `fields-grid` chunk fails once (a network blip, a deploy that swapped chunk names), shows the error boundary from then on. It does not recover until the page is reloaded, even when the chunk is reachable again. `loadGridFieldWidget` retries on failure, but the lazy component above it has already cached the rejection.

## To do

1. Measure it: fail the chunk load once in a test, then let it succeed, and record whether a later mount of `GridField` renders.
2. If it does not recover, make the lazy face retry: build the lazy component from the retrying loader, or reset it after a failure, so a later mount loads again.
3. Check the console's other lazy faces built the same way (for example `fields-date-picker`) and list any with the same edge.

## Acceptance

- After one failed load of the `fields-grid` chunk, a later mount of `GridField` renders once the chunk is reachable, with no page reload.

## Grade
p3 · domain:ui. An edge on a transient failure; a reload clears it.
